The run's web_fetch proxy served a ticker stamped 2026-09-08T06:44:20Z - 11 hours and 0 minutes stale, price 78,420 - and it was DISCARDED under the freshness guard before anything was built on it. reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,624.6 - the low of today's 13:00 UTC flush, 951.8 points under spot and 2.40 hourly ATRs away. The gate is deliberately moved DOWN from morning's 78,000.0, which is the level that whipsawed this session: the 13:00 UTC candle settled at 77,972.5, 27.5 points through the trigger, and price was back above 78,900 two hours later. Re-arming a gate at a level the tape has just proved is inside the noise band would repeat the error rather than learn from it. Below 77,624.6 the flush low has failed on a settled basis and the next structure is the 4H EMA100 at 77,493.17, then the 03 September low at 76,963.2.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 78,900.0, 323.6 points over spot and 0.82 hourly ATRs away. That level is not chosen from the chart - it is where 206,942 USD of measured SHORT liquidations sit, 30 buy-side fills and the single brightest cluster in the rolling window. Morning's 78,810.0 gate technically FIRED on the 15:00 UTC close of 78,905.4 and then failed to hold, with the 16:00 and 17:00 candles settling back at 78,730.7 and 78,565.8. That failure is why the bar is raised: the level worth paying for is the one that clears the squeeze fuel, not the one that merely touches it.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from morning's REDUCE to ADD, and the reason is the single condition midnight wrote down two sessions ago: size is decided by open interest, not price - if it has FALLEN the flush finished and the next tranche is earned. It has fallen. Open interest is 2,206,757,433 USD against morning's 2,217,046,617, DOWN 0.46 percent, roughly 10.3 million dollars of notional removed while price rose 269.7 points. That is the first easing in five sessions and it is the right kind: notional leaving on a rally, not on a decline. Funding has dropped 26.7 percent, from +0.0000601863 to +0.0000441254. The 1H long/short account ratio has ticked 1.27 to 1.26, its first fall of the week after four consecutive rises. And the 13:00 UTC candle actually did the work - a 929.3-point wick to 77,624.6 that took out morning's 78,181.6 floor, cleared the crowded longs, and reversed. The liquidation book has flipped with it: 95 of the last 100 fills are SHORT-side, 431,630 USD against 66,969 USD of longs. Gates: reduce moved DOWN from 78,000.0 to 77,624.6 because 78,000.0 whipsawed, add raised from 78,810.0 to 78,900.0 because 78,810.0 fired and immediately failed, invalidation moved from 77,459.84 to 77,493.17 as the 4H EMA100 drifted up.

liquidation.note: 206,942 USD of the 498,598 USD measured in the rolling 100-fill OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP window - 30 buy-side fills, every one of them a SHORT being closed, struck on the 15:00-16:00 UTC run to 78,970.8. Measured realized-liquidation data, not an estimate. This is the same 78,900 shelf that burned 823,638 USD of shorts at 07:08 COT, so it has now been paid for twice in six hours and it is still the densest fuel on the board.

129,491 USD across 34 fills, 33 buy-side and 1 sell-side. The band between spot and 78,900 is not empty - a move up has to grind through this before it reaches the magnet, which is exactly why the add gate was set above it rather than inside it.

33,608 USD across 24 buy-side fills. Numerous but small - these are retail-sized shorts being taken out in a thin band, which is why the notional is a sixth of the 78,900 cluster despite being nearly as many fills.
52,780 USD across 8 fills, 7 buy and 1 sell. Spot is sitting 23.6 points under this band, so it is the first thing a bounce has to clear.

75,777 USD across 4 fills but only 1 buy against 3 sells - the only band in the window where LONGS are the ones being liquidated, and it is 76.4 points beneath spot. It is a thin floor rather than a real magnet: four fills is not a wall, and the feed's 100-fill cap means the window does not reach down to the 77,624.6 flush at all.

Morning 08 September joins 06 September morning, 07 September end of day and 08 September midnight as the fourth recent failure, but it fails for the opposite reason to the other three: those added into rising open interest, this one trimmed into a flush that reversed.
calibration.note: BOTH morning gates fired, in opposite directions, two hours apart - the worst outcome a gate pair can produce and the most instructive. The 78,000.0 reduce gate FIRED first: the 13:00 UTC hourly candle settled at 77,972.5, 27.5 points through the trigger, after wicking 929.3 points to 77,624.6 and taking out morning's 78,181.6 floor. Then the 78,810.0 add gate FIRED at 15:00 UTC on a settled close of 78,905.4, 95.4 points through. A trader who followed both instructions sold at roughly 77,972 and bought back at roughly 78,905 - a 933-point loss for doing exactly as told. The 77,459.84 invalidation held; price came within 165 points of it and turned. The discretionary side also lost, though far less: morning trimmed 12 percent of the spot core at 78,306.7 and price now marks 78,576.4, so the trim is 269.7 points early, -0.34 percent on the sold portion, roughly -0.06 USDT. Marked false. What morning got RIGHT is the part worth keeping: it refused the second spot tranche because open interest was still rising, and open interest has now fallen for the first time in five sessions. The condition was correct, the timing of the trim around it was not, and the 41.20 USDT of cash that refusal preserved is what this session is buying with.
